item.text:
The module calculates order totals, applies two coupon codes, computes an average, and renders an order receipt.

Bugs in [test/orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-2FuNoZ/test/orders.js):

- **Definite:** `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length` ([line 5](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-2FuNoZ/test/orders.js:5)). The final iteration reads `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, causing a `TypeError`. This breaks `calcTotal`, `averageItemPrice`, and `formatOrder` for every array. Use `< items.length`.
- **Likely semantic bug:** `averageItemPrice` divides the total including quantities by the number of line items ([line 20](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-2FuNoZ/test/orders.js:20)). For `2 × $10`, it returns `$20`, not an average per item of `$10`. It should divide by total quantity if “item” means unit; empty input also needs defined handling.
- **Invalid coupon edge case:** `applyDiscount(100, "toString")` treats an inherited object property as a discount and returns `NaN`. Check own properties (for example, `Object.hasOwn(discounts, code)`).
- **Minor formatting edge case:** an order with no items would render a leading newline before `Total:`.
